messages.subject: where is the syntax at?
parts:
Hi,

Eric and I are doing the Stan workshop at ODSC next Friday (20th of May) and I'm wondering which syntax to teach (I thought rstan was already on "lp +=" rather than increment_log_prob and "=" for assignment rather than "<-" but now I'm not sure (my stuff doesn't compile with "=" for assignment and "update.packages" isn't updating rstan... any suggestions on which syntax to go with for the best workshop experience?

Krzysztof
